name: Future Temporal Knowledge Graph Extraction Dataset
description: A synthetic evaluation dataset for temporal knowledge graph extraction (TKGE) constructed from predicted future, previously unseen temporal facts to eliminate data contamination and enable robust benchmarking.
reputation: A recent synthetic benchmark that is gaining attention for contamination-resistant temporal knowledge graph extraction evaluation, but is not yet broadly established.
notes: Dataset consists of 4.2K future quadruples and textual descriptions; enables continuous creation of contamination-free future temporal datasets.
